# Overdue invoices from the heating contractor

Eastgate's heating contractor sent three overdue invoices in February for the boiler work done last fall. The branch manager had approved the work, but the invoices went to the wrong address and sat unpaid. The contractor added late fees to each one.

The finance office paid the invoices in March and asked the contractor to waive the late fees, which it did once. All facilities invoices now go to the finance office directly.
